CountChild####azurerm_lb_backend_address: If azurerm_lb.b.sku is of certain value, Then the number of azurerm_lb_backend_address_pool that could depend on azurerm_lb.b is restricted to certain value
Negation####azurerm_lb_backend_address_p: If azurerm_lb_backend_address_pool.a.synchronous_mode is null or empty, Then azurerm_lb_backend_address_pool.a.virtual_network_id is null (i.e. it does not refer to azurerm_virtual_network.id)
If azurerm_lb_backend_address_pool.a.tunnel_interface is null or empty, Then azurerm_lb_backend_address_pool.a.virtual_network_id is null (i.e. it does not refer to azurerm_virtual_network.id)
